jobs.title: Client Onboarding & Growth Specialist (Med Spa Industry)
jobs.description:
**Client Onboarding & Growth Specialist**

Holistic Money | Remote (U.S. Eastern hours) | Full-time | $23 to $26 per hour plus PTO and bonus

**Read this first**

Holistic Money is a fast-growing startup. This is the first hire in a brand new department. You will carry real responsibility from week one, help build the process and the team, and grow as fast as the business does. We are not looking for the most experienced person. We are looking for the hungriest one.

**This is you**

* You want the most out of life, and you are not waiting for someone to hand it to you
* You push yourself. When something is hard, you lean in
* You are ambitious, well spoken, and confident on camera
* You take pride in how you show up: on time, prepared, and put together
* You get a kick out of a client saying yes

**Who we are**

Holistic Money provides Fractional CFO services and bookkeeping to fast-growing med spas. Our clients are female founders: the women owners and injectors you already know. If you have worked in a med spa, you understand them better than most finance people ever will.

**What you will do**

* Be the main point of contact for every new client from "yes" to "live"
* Lead onboarding calls on Zoom: collect logins, connect bank and EMR accounts, set expectations
* Work a checklist and chase missing items until the client is fully set up
* Explain what is happening in plain English and make the first month feel calm and professional
* Spot clients who are ready for a higher service tier and lead that conversation. You earn a bonus every time one says yes
* Hand off cleanly to the bookkeeping and CFO team, and turn every repeated question into a template or FAQ

**What we are looking for**

* Experience working in a med spa or aesthetics practice (front desk, patient coordinator, practice manager, sales). Years do not matter. Knowing the world does
* No bookkeeping or finance background required. We will teach you the finance side; we cannot teach you the industry
* Warm but not a pushover. You can kindly hold a client to a deadline
* Detail-oriented, comfortable with Zoom, Google Drive, Slack, and a project management tool
* Consistent availability for scheduled calls on U.S. Eastern time

**Pay**

$23 to $26 per hour, full time, with paid time off, plus an uncapped bonus for every client you move from our lowest tier to our highest. The people who do this well will out-earn the base quickly. If you want a high starting rate and a quiet desk, this is not the role. If you want a place to prove yourself and grow fast, apply.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short video to info@holistic-money.com (two minutes or less) telling us why you want this role and what you learned working in a med spa. We want to see you on camera before we ever get on a call.

Pay: $23.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* The first step of the process is to send a 2 minute video presentation of yourself explaining your background and why you're interested in the role. Please send to info@holistic-money.com . Candidates will not be considered if you do not complete this step. If you have sent your video, please reply yes to this question.

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
***Our Mission***
=================

*ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction*.

***Our Solution***
==================

*Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.*

***Our Culture & Values***
==========================

*Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.*

**Role Overview**
=================

ButterflyMX is seeking a Client Onboarding Specialist to help new and existing clients successfully onboard, understand, and use our products. This client-facing role combines thoughtful communication, strong organization, and technical aptitude to create a smooth onboarding experience.

You will work directly with clients to coordinate onboarding activities, provide training, support product setup and integrations, and address questions along the way. You will partner across internal teams to keep work moving, maintain visibility into open requests, and help clients feel confident using ButterflyMX.

Success in this role requires ownership, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. You will manage multiple priorities, solve problems as they arise, and help improve the processes and resources that make client onboarding more effective as we scale.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Guide new and existing clients through onboarding by communicating key steps, setting clear expectations, and helping teams understand how to use ButterflyMX solutions through email, phone, and video support.
* Simultaneously onboard multiple projects and clients, maintaining clear communication and timely follow-through.
* Provide initial and refresher training on ButterflyMX products, administrative tools, and relevant features.
* Support clients through product setup, integrations, troubleshooting, onboarding challenges, and engaging internal teams when needed.
* Maintain accurate records, ticket updates, and onboarding documentation to ensure work is visible and actionable.
* Work collaboratively with Client Success, Technical Support, Implementation, and other internal teams to drive client outcomes and ensure continuity in the client experience.
* Identify and provide feedback on recurring questions, onboarding friction, and opportunities to improve client education, processes, and resources.

**Requirements**
================

* 2+ years of experience in client onboarding, client support, customer service, or a similar client-facing role, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment.
* Experience using Zendesk or another ticketing platform to manage client requests, document interactions, and track resolutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.
* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn new products, systems, and integrations.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented approach with reliable follow-through and sound judgment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and client stakeholders.
* Maintain a professional, client-focused presence by keeping your camera on during scheduled video calls with clients, fostering engagement, building rapport, and delivering an exceptional onboarding experience.
* Knowledge of property management, proptech, or hardware-enabled SaaS is a plus.
* Proven experience with leveraging AI tools in both professional and personal settings.
* ButterflyMX is an AI-forward organization, and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in every role.

**Compensation**
================

The expected base salary range for this position is $30-35/hr. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.

**Benefits**
============

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans (ButterflyMX covers 80% of the cost) starting day 1
* 401(k) plan with a match
* 10 paid holidays, 20 vacation days, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays
* Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)
* Short and Long Term Disability (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)
* Paid Family Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* Quarterly self-care stipends
* Access to optional benefits including pre-tax flexible healthcare spending accounts (FSA and HSA), Dependent Care FSA, and Commuter Benefits, as well as optional Supplemental Life, AD&D, Hospital Indemnity, Legal, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet, and Personal Liability Insurance
* And more!

*ButterflyMX is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. You must have the authorization to work in the US to become an employee. We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates and employees. If you need reasonable accommodations during the application or the recruiting process, please let our recruiting team know.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist (approx 3 month assignment)
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a temporary Implementation Specialist for approximately 3 months to get new clients live on Foureyes products. You'll own each setup from enrollment through launch, so every account is configured, tested, and ready to go.

You'll sit on the Technical Support team and work closely with Sales, Support, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll do the setup work yourself and keep dealers and our internal teams updated along the way.

**What you'll do**
------------------

You'll be the person who gets new clients across the finish line, from the day they enroll to the day they're live.

* Own each setup from start to finish across every Foureyes product, keeping track of each store and each step so nothing stalls along the way
* Configure our technical implementations (integrations, data feeds, tracking, and the rest), then test and validate them so every client launches with a setup we can stand behind
* Give internal stakeholders a daily update on progress, blockers, and timelines so Sales, Support, and Product always know where things stand
* Follow up with dealers consistently to get what's needed from them and wrap up setup on time

**What you bring**
------------------

* 2 to 4 years in implementation, onboarding, technical operations, or another customer-facing technical role
* Comfort with technical systems, data feeds, and integrations (CRM experience is a plus)
* Working knowledge of SQL
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to run several implementations at once
* Analytical problem solving and data validation skills
* The ability to follow a structured process, spot where it could be better, and hit deadlines in a fast-moving environment
* SaaS experience preferred
* Bonus points for automotive technology experience

**Please note that the candidate selected will be payrolled through a third-party staffing partner, and won’t be a regular Foureyes employee.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

jobs.title: Client Success & Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job title:** Client Onboarding Specialist – Meta Business Manager & GoHighLevel (Remote)

**Job type:** Contract (1099) · Part-time  
**Location:** Remote – United States only

**About Us**

We’re a growing digital marketing agency serving the network marketing space. We help our clients launch Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns that generate leads and booked calls, supported by GoHighLevel CRM systems.

We’re looking for a polished, client-facing specialist to own the first stage of our client experience. This is an independent contractor role. It starts part-time, and for the right person there’s a clear path to more hours and responsibility.

**About the Role**

This is not a behind-the-scenes position. You’ll lead Zoom calls with our clients and be the face of our onboarding and launch process. Professionalism, patience, and clear communication are essential.

**Responsibilities**

*Onboarding calls (about 75 minutes)*

* Walk clients through creating their Facebook advertising assets: Business Manager, Business Page, Ad Account, and Pixel
* Share those assets to our company Business Manager (this is not an ads management role, but you should have basic Ads Manager experience)
* Troubleshoot Meta policy, access, and Identity Verification issues live on the call
* Handle GoHighLevel admin tasks: connecting domains, setting up email senders, and submitting A2P / Toll-Free verifications

*Pre-launch calls (about 30 minutes)*

* Prepare clients for what happens once their ads go live, including how leads come in, how calls get booked, and what to expect in the first few weeks
* Show clients how to manage leads and booked calls in their GoHighLevel pipeline
* Answer common questions about our ad process and explain how weekly lead reporting works (we’ll fully train you on our process and talking points)

*Growth opportunity*

* For the right fit, this role can expand into more client support and project management as we scale

**Qualifications**

* Located in the United States and available during business hours
* Extensive hands-on experience with Meta Business Manager and GoHighLevel
* Basic working knowledge of Facebook Ads Manager
* Experience working directly with clients, not just back-office agency work
* Confident and polished on video calls
* Able to explain technical steps simply to non-technical clients
* Organized, reliable, and able to represent a brand without hand-holding
* Looking for a long-term role you can grow into, not a short gig

**Contract Details**

* 1099 independent contractor; you’ll provide a W-9
* You provide your own computer, reliable internet, and a professional workspace

**How to Apply**  
Apply through Indeed and include a link to a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and describing your experience with Meta, GoHighLevel, and client-facing work. Bonus points if you briefly explain how you’d walk a brand-new client through a GHL pipeline.

Applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed.

Pay: $40.00 - $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 20.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Please paste the link to your 2–3 minute Loom video.

Experience:

* GoHighLevel: 1 year (Required)
* Meta Business Manager: 1 year (Required)

Location:

* United States (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Claims Training Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Help Shape the Future of Claims Learning**

  

We're seeking an experienced property claims professional to help build and deliver technical learning programs that strengthen claim handling quality, compliance, customer outcomes, and associate development.

In this role, you'll combine deep claims expertise with training, coaching, and quality analysis to identify performance opportunities, develop learning solutions, and influence claims excellence across the organization.

  
  

### **What You'll Do**

  

**Build Learning Solutions**

* Design and develop technical training, job aids, claim scenarios, assessments, and learning resources.
* Translate audit findings, regulatory changes, and business initiatives into practical learning solutions.
* Support onboarding, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.
  

  

**Deliver Training & Develop Talent**

* Facilitate engaging instructor-led and virtual learning experiences.
* Lead technical claims, compliance, quality, and operational training initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted resource supporting associate growth and capability development.
  

  

**Identify Opportunities for Improvement**

* Conduct claim file audits and quality reviews to assess adherence to claim handling standards, policy provisions, and regulatory requirements.
* Analyze trends, performance gaps, and root causes to identify development opportunities.
* Provide actionable recommendations that improve quality, compliance, and operational performance.
  

  

**Measure Impact**

* Evaluate training effectiveness through audits, assessments, feedback, and performance results.
* Monitor improvement efforts and continuously refine learning content and delivery methods.
* Provide leadership with insights on trends, risks, and learning outcomes.
  

  

**Partner Across Claims**

* Collaborate with Claims leadership, Quality & Compliance, Operations, and business partners to support organizational goals.
* Support regulatory, system, process, and business transformation initiatives.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on claims quality, compliance, and learning effectiveness.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* **Adjuster license is required.**
* 5+ years of property claims or related P&C insurance experience.
* Strong knowledge of policy interpretation, coverage analysis, claim investigation, settlement practices, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience conducting claim audits, quality reviews, compliance reviews, coaching, or performance improvement activities.
* Experience developing, facilitating, or delivering training and knowledge-transfer initiatives.
* Working knowledge of claims systems and estimating platforms such as Xactimate.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and organizational skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Homeowners or property claims expertise.
* Experience in quality assurance, compliance, audit, or learning and development functions.
* Instructional design, training, coaching, quality, or compliance certifications.
* Experience with Workday Learning and SharePoint.
* Experience supporting large-scale operational or organizational change initiatives.
* Xactimate Level 1 certification
  

  
  

### **Why Consider This Opportunity?**

This newly created role offers the opportunity to help build a long-term technical claims learning capability, influence claims quality and compliance, and make a broad organizational impact without direct people management. The role is ideal for a highly respected claims professional looking to leverage their expertise in a new way while helping shape the future of claims development.

jobs.title: Software Training Specialist w/Top Secret Clearance (Temporary)
jobs.description:
A3 Consulting is looking for an experienced Software Training Specialist to support a major modernization effort for a federal defense customer. If you excel at designing and delivering multi-channel training—ranging from instructor-led sessions to digital learning assets and quick-reference guides—to drive seamless enterprise software adoption, this role is for you!

**In this role you will**:

* Support the development and delivery of engaging, role-based training that prepares users to effectively adopt new system capabilities, processes, and workflows.
* Conduct training needs assessments and work with stakeholders and functional teams to identify audience-specific learning objectives, knowledge gaps, and training requirements.
* Monitor upcoming releases, sprint deliverables, and system changes to proactively assess training impacts and ensure training materials remain aligned with the current production environment.
* Develop realistic system demonstrations, exercises, scenarios, and hands-on learning activities that reflect operational workflows and user roles.
* Establish and track training effectiveness measures, including attendance, completion, learner feedback, knowledge assessments, and adoption trends, and recommend improvements based on results.
* Facilitate training content reviews and validation sessions with functional SMEs, technical teams, and Government stakeholders to ensure training accurately reflects approved system functionality and operational processes.
* Design, update, and maintain tailored curriculum, role-based training modules, user manuals, quick-reference guides, and interactive e-learning materials for a modernized case management system.
* Conduct engaging live (in-person and virtual) training sessions, classroom workshops, and train-the-trainer programs for varied user groups, from front-line end-users to system administrators.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and Agile teams to translate newly released features, enhancements, and system workflows into functional training assets.
* Ensure all training assets comply with federal standards, agency security protocols, and operational workflows.
* Support change management efforts by assessing user impacts and developing targeted training and communications to promote successful adoption of new system capabilities and processes.
* Support release readiness by aligning training materials, user guides, and communications with planned software releases and deployment schedules.
* Gather end-user and post-release feedback to identify training gaps, adoption challenges, system pain points, and opportunities to improve future training and release readiness.

**Required Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Training and Development, Communications, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
* 3+ years of software training, instructional design, or technical adoption experience.
* Direct experience supporting federal government agency programs (defense or intelligence community preferred) as a government contractor.
* Proven track record delivering training for enterprise software solutions, web applications, or custom-built case management systems.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with an ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience developing instructor-led training (ILT), virtual instructor-led training (VILT), e-learning, user guides, job aids, and quick-reference materials.
* Experience conducting training needs assessments and developing role-based curricula.
* Experience supporting software implementations, modernization efforts, or organizational/user adoption initiatives.
* Ability to quickly learn complex technical systems and translate system functionality into understandable user-focused instruction.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments and supporting training needs associated with iterative software releases.
* Experience managing multiple training deliverables and deadlines in a fast-paced release environment.

**Desired Qualifications**:

* Experience training users on ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow/case management platforms.
* Experience developing interactive e-learning and digital training content using Articulate 360 (Storyline and/or Rise), Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, or comparable instructional design tools.
* Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting training content delivered through Learning Management Systems (LMS) or federal training platforms; familiarity with DCSA's Security Training, Education, and Professionalization Portal (STEPP) preferred.
* Familiarity with organizational change management principles and supporting user adoption during software releases, system implementations, or modernization initiatives.

**Clearance Level**:

* Active Top Secret Required.

**Location**:

* Washington, D.C. Area (Remote).

**Salary Range**:

* $133,000-142,000 commensurate with experience and achievements.

**Benefit Information**:

A3 Consulting offers a robust benefits package to include but not limited to medical, dental, and vision benefits, flexible spending and health savings accounts, group life and AD&D, short-term and long-term disability, paid time off, 401k match, paid parental leave, professional development.

**About A3 Consulting**:

A3 Consulting LLC is a leading management and technology firm that specializes in providing innovative solutions to solve the pressing challenges of our Federal government and Department of Defense customers. With a proven track record of delivering mission-critical solutions and exceptional performance, we are committed to ensuring that our intelligent automation and technology offerings remain competitive in the rapidly evolving defense marketplace.

  

A3 Consulting, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.
